articles.title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,200 arrested after protests
articles.description: Disorder broke out in cities across the country on a day in which more than half a million joined cost of living protests.

articles.title: Watch: Moment historic French town hall spire collapses in flames amid protests
articles.description: An historic town hall in the southern French city of Limoges was set ablaze during national protests.

articles.title: More NHS staff sacked over attacks victims' records
articles.description: Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust says a new system will be brought in to protect records.

articles.title: Deaths confirmed in major fire at Canada military base
articles.description: Number of casualties unknown in "very, very active and delicate" situation in Alberta, says defence minister.
